description: This Java class 'UserService' manages user creation, retrieval, and updating within a finance application, integrating with Keycloak for authentication and a banking core service for user verification.

classes.name: UserService
classes.description: Service class handling user management, including creation, retrieval, and updates, with integration to Keycloak and banking services.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Creates a new user after verifying email and banking identification, registers with Keycloak, and saves to the database.

methods.name: readUsers
methods.description: Retrieves a paginated list of users, enriching data with Keycloak user info.

methods.name: readUser
methods.description: Fetches a user by ID from the database.

methods.name: updateUser
methods.description: Updates user status and enables Keycloak user if approved.
